title.narrative: BBNJ - Global and regional support to the BBNJ Agreement ratification process and implementation readiness.

description.narrative: 88. Through its support to the entry into force process of the BBNJ Agreement and to the implementation readiness at global and regional levels – in particular of countries that are eligible for GEF support, including least developed countries (LDCs), landlocked least developed countries (LLDCs) and SIDS – the MSP will create benefits in terms of knowledge and capacity. Contributing in this way to an early as possible initial implementation of the BBNJ Agreement, important benefits will be created through the conservation and sustainable use of marine biodiversity and ecosystems, as indicated in previous sections. 89. The BBNJ Agreement will enhance efforts to tackle environmental challenges and promote the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity in ABNJ. Several provisions of the BBNJ Agreement will support inclusive ocean management, including those related to the traditional knowledge and participation of IP&LC, on gender responsiveness of capacity-building and on gender balance and equitable geographic representation in the composition of the bodies established under the BBNJ Agreement. It will also promote marine scientific research and facilitate the generation and dissemination of data and information to help improve our knowledge of marine biodiversity in the ABNJ.90. Most importantly, the BBNJ Agreement will bring socio-economic benefits by: a) build countries capacity to carry out and benefit from activities with respect to MGRs of ABNJ and digital sequence information on such resources, ensuring that such activities are in the interests of all States and for the benefit of all humanity; b) to enable ABMTs, including MPAs, to be established in ABNJ, which will contribute to protecting and restoring ecosystems and strengthening resilience to stressors, including climate change, ocean acidification and marine pollution; c) to assist in preventing and minimizing impacts on the marine environment, including through its provisions on EIAs; and d) to assist States in strengthening cooperation and coordination and in undertaking activities in ABNJ through the steady provision of CB&TMT.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
To foster international cooperation towards the swift entry into force of the BBNJ Agreement and to promote implementation readiness at the global and the regional level.
